}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "S LM4A", and "SiPEED Lichee Module 4A" are silkscreened on module top.
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Alibaba T-Head]] TH1520 Xuantie C910 @1.85GHz :SoC: Quad-Core RISC-V (RV64GC) 64-bit :NPU: 4.0 TOPS @1GHz *GPU: ''Imagination'' BXM-4-64 @800MHz :(OpenGL ES3.1, OpenVG 1.2, Vulkan 1.2) :VPU: H.264/H.265 decoder up to 4Kp75, :H.265 encoder up to 4Kp40 *Storage: 128GB eMMC 5.1 Flash *Memory: 16GB (LPDDR4X) SDRAM (''[[Rayson]]'') *Network: 2x GbE ports *Power Source: 5V/2A via SODIMM Connector
==Links of Interest== *[https://wiki.sipeed.com/hardware/en/lichee/th1520/lm4a.html ''LicheePi Module 4A'' on '''SiPEED Wiki'''] *[https://www.cnx-software.com/2022/12/14/sipeed-lm4a-t-head-th1520-risc-v-module-to-power-raspberry-pi-4-competitor-and-cluster-board/ ''Sipeed LM4A – T-Head TH1520 RISC-V module'' on '''CNX|Software'''] *[https://linuxgizmos.com/lichee-pi-4a-risc-v-platform-available-for-pre-order/ ''Lichee Pi 4A RISC-V platform available for pre-order'' on '''LinuxGizmos''']
